text: I've been using this product for 3 months now and it's completely transformed how I work. The onboarding was smooth and the support team (specifically John at support@company.com) was incredibly helpful. Would definitely recommend to colleagues!
Absolute disaster. I was charged twice for my subscription in March. I called 555-867-5309 three times and nobody could fix it. I'm cancelling and going to Competitor X. This is unacceptable.

The mobile app keeps crashing whenever I try to export reports. It happened on iOS 17 and also on my colleague Sarah Johnson's Android device. I've had to use the desktop version as a workaround but it's really slowing me down.

Honestly pretty average. Nothing special compared to what I was using before. Setup took longer than expected and I had to watch 4 tutorial videos before I understood the dashboard. Not bad but not great either.

I love the new analytics dashboard! I've been asking for drill-down filters for months and you finally added them. One thing I'd still love to see is a dark mode option and the ability to export directly to Google Sheets.

My account was locked without any warning and I lost access to 2 years of data. My SSN 123-45-6789 was required to verify identity which felt very wrong. This is a serious data privacy concern and I'm consulting my lawyer.

Switched from CompetitorY last year and it's been mostly positive. The pricing is better and the API is well-documented. Bulk export is still slower than what we had before though. Support response times could be faster too.

The checkout process is broken. My credit card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was charged but the order never confirmed. I've emailed billing@theircompany.com twice and gotten no response in 5 days. Very frustrated.

Fantastic customer service experience today! The agent resolved my billing question in under 10 minutes. I upgraded to the Pro plan because of how well I was treated. More companies should take notes.

App is fine for basic use but we really need a team collaboration feature. My whole team at Acme Corp keeps asking when multi-user workspaces will be available. We might have to look at alternatives if this isn't on the roadmap.
